items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the functor equalities of the three parts at source lines 1290-1307, label lemma-iso-go-up, whose proof occupies source lines 1309-1327. The proof is not a citation: it first proves a general pullback stability statement (a map of quasi-coherent modules and its pullback along a surjective flat morphism agree on isomorphism, injectivity, surjectivity and zero) via faithfully flat local ring maps, then restricts the test points to the two supports and invokes commutation of supports with base change for finite type modules to convert the image hypothesis into preimages at all relevant support points. The counted statement records neither the general stability argument nor the support reduction.
